### Advanced Phishing Tactics: A Detailed Exploration

Phishing remains one of the most prevalent and damaging forms of cybercrime, with attackers continuously evolving their tactics to bypass security measures and deceive victims. This paper explores some of the latest email spoofing techniques employed by malicious actors, focusing on display name hijacking, link manipulation, and embedded media abuse.

#### 1. Display Name Hijacking

Display name hijacking is a technique where attackers manipulate the display name of an email sender to impersonate a trusted entity. This method exploits the fact that many users do not scrutinize the email address itself, focusing instead on the name that appears in their inbox.
